title: How do you make the MZ text window opaque instead of the default dim?

posts.author: Traveling Bard
posts.body:
I feel like I've spent way too long on this... But here's what I'm seeing on a fresh project from latest rpg maker mz, no plugins, no anything:
That picture is window color set to blue 255, the Show Text background is set to Window, and System 2's Window Opacity is set to 255. What am I doing wrong? lol I'm trying to get it so it can be read over lava without making my eyes bleed. Something like here in the preview:
Thoughts? Thanks in advance

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: You need to edit the window skin (Window.png). The picture itself is semi transparent.

posts.author: Traveling Bard
posts.body:
Yes, thanks for the help! I removed that bottom left corner to remove the mesh pattern & will update the top left corner with non-transparent colors. While digging into this, I found a rpgmakerweb blog on what makes up a windowskin
here
. Very helpful stuff

posts.author: Andar
posts.body: an alternative without editing the windowskin (which changes this for every show text and menu) would have been to use a show picture to place any background and follow it with a show text set to transparent background
